name: threadwake
description: A deterministic public evaluation workspace for the Threadwake workgraph proposal.
author: Albert Buchard

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @threadwake/contracts && npm run build --workspace @threadwake/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace @threadwake/app
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:app-qa && npm run check:public-package
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @threadwake/contracts && npm run build --workspace @threadwake/mcp-server && vitest run packages/contracts packages/mcp-server && npm run test --workspace @threadwake/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @threadwake/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @threadwake/mcp-server && npm run typecheck --workspace @threadwake/app
